第 34 章 Friday Wins and a Case Study in Ritual Design周五庆功与仪式设计案例研究

Kellan Elliott-McCrea / 凯兰·埃利奥特-麦克雷

— 第 102 页 —

Culture is what you celebrate. Rituals are the tools you use to shape culture. Yet very few of us think much about ritual design.

文化是你庆祝什么。仪式是你用来塑造文化的工具。但我们很少有人认真思考仪式设计。

A standard piece of software development practice that many teams let lapse, or merely let lapse into being suboptimal is "Friday Wins," sometimes called sprint demos or sprint reviews. But you can take what can be a flaccid and repetitive meeting and make it a valuable ritual by grounding it in values.

一个很多团队放任荒废、或者只是荒废到次优状态的标准软件开发实践是「周五庆功」，有时叫 Sprint 演示或 Sprint 评审。但你可以把一个可能疲软重复的会议，通过把它锚定在价值观上，变成一个有价值的仪式。

When I'm designing Friday Wins, here are the handful of values I'm thinking about in my ritual design:

当我设计周五庆功时，我在仪式设计中考虑的几个价值观是：

Learning oriented学习导向

Learning-oriented cultures look forward to and eagerly participate in reviews. If your team dreads postmortems or has lackluster end-of-sprint reviews, it's likely that you aren't facilitating a learning-oriented culture. Rather than saving reflections for when something has gone wrong, make the cadence of a weekly Commit-Reflect cycle the heart of your software process, and make reflection a thing to look forward to. Call it "Friday Wins" versus "Sprint Review."

学习导向的文化期待并热切参与评审。如果你的团队害怕事后复盘或者 Sprint 末评审索然无味，很可能你没有在促进学习导向的文化。不要把反思留到出问题时才做，让每周「承诺-反思」循环的节奏成为你软件过程的核心，让反思成为一件期待的事。叫它「周五庆功」而不是「Sprint 评审」。

Organizational awareness组织感知

The insight that you can't predict who needs what information in a complex system drove NASA's original "systems management" insight, and most high-performing technology organizations since. (see also Team of Teams). Friday Wins should be maximizing for ambient awareness and chance encounters.

在复杂系统中你无法预测谁需要什么信息这个洞见，推动了 NASA 最初的「系统管理」洞见，以及此后大多数高绩效技术组织。（另见《Team of Teams》）周五庆功应该最大化环境感知和偶遇。

Don't silo wins by team. Invite the largest number of people who can reasonably attend. Invest in making attendance easy (support for remotes, no meeting policies, etc.).

不要把庆功按团队隔离。邀请合理数量能参加的人。投资让参加更容易（支持远程、无会议政策等）。

Shipping交付

If you've worked on one of my teams, you know that I believe that a relentless focus on shipping is the primary driver of team effectiveness. Shorter cycle times have been shown to lead to both higher productivity and greater happiness. Value and learning are both primarily captured only after a project is finished. Confidence is gained most quickly in production. And so on, and so forth. If shipping is one of your values, center it in your rituals.

如果你在我的团队待过，你知道我认为无情地专注交付是团队效能的主要驱动力。更短的周期时间已被证明能带来更高的生产力和更大的幸福感。价值和学习都主要在项目完成后才能获得。信心最快在生产中获得。等等。如果交付是你的价值观之一，把它放在仪式的中心。

— 第 103 页 —

Do not present work at wins that's almost done, almost done waiting for a PR, will be merged to master next, is merged to master but hasn't been deployed. Wins need to align with your values.

不要在庆功上展示快完成的、快完成但在等 PR 的、马上要合到 master 的、合到 master 但还没部署的工作。庆功需要和你的价值观对齐。

Modern software is cross-functional现代软件是跨职能的

Graphs count as wins, UIs count as wins, analysis of customer request behavior counts as a win, a new training module rolled out to the company counts as a win.

图表算庆功，UI 算庆功，客户请求行为分析算庆功，向公司推出的新培训模块算庆功。

How software is made is important (part 1)软件怎么做出来很重要（第一部分）

Most modern companies can succeed only when there is a high degree of mutual respect between different disciplines within the company. One small part of that is Friday Wins that include people who aren't on the software engineering team (this is a value that is distinct and in addition to Organizational Awareness).

大多数现代公司只有在公司内部不同学科之间有高度互相尊重时才能成功。其中一小部分是周五庆功包括不在软件工程团队的人（这是一个独立于组织感知之外的价值观）。

How software is made is important (part 2)软件怎么做出来很重要（第二部分）

In a "tech company" or "tech-led company" the value and limitations of software is generally understood to some degree. As software continues to transform more problem areas it is important that the process of building software is understood and respected (in both its strength and limits). One key building block for this is making sure high-prestige individuals outside of engineering demonstrate that they care not only about results but about the process. Invite the CEO to wins.

在「科技公司」或「技术驱动公司」里，软件的价值和局限通常在某种程度上被理解。随着软件继续改变更多问题领域，构建软件的过程被理解和尊重（在其优势和局限两方面）很重要。一个关键构件是确保工程之外的高声望人士展示他们不仅关心结果也关心过程。邀请 CEO 来庆功。

Inclusive and high energy包容且高能

This is a weekly celebration. We have rules (time limits, only things in production, etc.), but it should be something people look forward to (or you should burn it down). This means that everyone should have a way to participate, even if you didn't have a "win" this week, and that everyone should be expected to participate, and that as a leader you need to make that a thing people look forward to.

这是每周的庆祝。我们有规则（时间限制、只有生产环境里的东西等），但它应该是人们期待的事（不然你就把它烧了吧）。这意味着每个人都应该有参与的方式，即使你这周没有「庆功」，每个人都应该被期待参与，而且作为领导你需要让它成为人们期待的事。

Have an alternative method for playing; for example, show a win or answer a weekly "icebreaker"-like question.

准备一个参与的替代方式；例如，展示一个庆功或回答一个每周的「破冰」问题。

— 第 104 页 —

Be prepared to draw folks out who don't recognize their own wins, and occasionally be prepared to put the win in the larger context of the goals.

准备好把不认识到自己庆功的人拉出来，偶尔准备好把庆功放在更大的目标背景中。

These are the things that I think about when I'm designing an end-of-week ritual. A lot of these values will bubble up in other rituals I design because they reflect culture values I want to see on my teams.

这些是我设计周末仪式时思考的事情。很多这些价值观会在我设计的其他仪式中浮现，因为它们反映了我想在团队中看到的文化价值观。

The point isn't that this is how you should design your sprint reviews or "Friday Wins." The point is to be intentional in how you design your rituals.

重点不是说你应该这样设计 Sprint 评审或「周五庆功」。重点是你要有意识地设计你的仪式。
